ansage_timeup.description:
Choose what is played before switching off.

**Bundled announcement** is the easiest choice: MedienStop.de picks the right file automatically – a video for the TV, an audio file for Alexa. Nothing to download, nothing to copy.

Only sources that actually work on your selected device are offered.

{ergebnis}

info.title: About MedienStop.de & support
info.description:
**MedienStop.de** – version {version}

Screen-time control for children, built alongside [medienstop.de]({website}).

- 📖 [Read the guide]({doku})
- 🌐 [medienstop.de]({website})
- 🐞 [Report a bug or ask a question]({issues})

---

This integration is free and will stay that way. If it helps you, a [small donation]({spende}) is very welcome – it keeps the project going. But it works just as well without. ❤️

options.shared_pin: Variant 1 – One dashboard for all (PIN per child)
options.per_child: Variant 2 – One dashboard per child (user sharing)

options.auto: Bundled announcement – matched to your device (recommended)
options.media: Your own file from the media browser
options.www: Your own file from the www/ folder

start_timer.name: Start timer (Play)
start_timer.description: Starts/resumes a child's timer. Only possible if remaining time > 0 and within the allowed time window. PIN required if set for the child.

pause_timer.name: Pause timer (Pause)
pause_timer.description: Pauses the running timer. The remaining time is kept.

stop_timer.name: Stop timer (Stop)
stop_timer.description: Sets the remaining time to 0. The child then has no time left for today and cannot start again.

add_time.name: Grant time (parents)
add_time.description: Adds minutes to ONE child or ALL children. Leave 'Child' empty or enter 'alle' = all children.

child.name: Child
child.description: Child ID (e.g. kind_1). Empty or 'alle' = all children.

set_pin.name: Set/clear PIN (parents)
set_pin.description: Sets a child's PIN anew (leave empty to remove the PIN).

pin.name: New PIN
pin.description: Leave empty to remove the PIN.

apply_budgets_now.name: Apply budgets now
apply_budgets_now.description: Immediately sets every child's remaining time to today's budget (otherwise this happens automatically at midnight).

create_dashboard.name: Create dashboard template
create_dashboard.description: Creates a ready-made dashboard template (parent + child view) as a copyable notification. Without input the configured number of children/profiles is used.

play_media.name: Stream video/image to the TV
play_media.description: Plays a media URL (mp4, image, audio) on the media_player entity selected as the TV.

media.name: Media file (pick)
media.description: Pick a file in the media browser.

url.name: or media URL
url.description: Alternatively a direct URL/path (http/https or media-source://...).

content_type.name: Media type
content_type.description: Optional: video, image or music (otherwise automatic).

test_video.name: Test video
test_video.description: Plays one of the configured videos immediately for testing.

reset_statistics.name: Reset statistics
reset_statistics.description: Resets the watched time (statistics) - for ONE child or ALL. Leave 'Child' empty or enter 'alle' = all children.

child.name: Child
child.description: Child ID (e.g. kind_1). Empty or 'alle' = all children.
